# Instagram Followers/Following Scraper | No Login | No Cookies

The Apify actor [`scraping_solutions/instagram-scraper-followers-following-no-cookies`](https://apify.com/scraping_solutions/instagram-scraper-followers-following-no-cookies) as typed Telo kinds, generated from its build **0.0.88**. The module's version is that build number, and every run it starts is pinned to exactly that build, so the input types below are the ones the actor really runs with.

Download Instagram followers or following from any public account. No login, no cookies required. Supports multiple usernames, auto-pagination, and continuation tokens for large exports. Export to JSON, CSV, Excel. Perfect for lead generation, influencer research, and competitor analysis.

## Pricing

Pay per event — result $0.00085 (Free-plan prices; paid plans pay less). Cap the spend with `maxTotalChargeUsd`.

Runs are charged to the Apify account whose token the `ApifyClient` holds. See the [Store page](https://apify.com/scraping_solutions/instagram-scraper-followers-following-no-cookies) for current prices.

## Usage

```yaml
kind: Actor.ApifyClient
metadata: { name: apify }
token: !cel "secrets.apifyToken"
---
kind: Actor.Run          # or Actor.Start for runs longer than 5 minutes
metadata: { name: scrape }
client: !ref apify
maxTotalChargeUsd: 1     # optional: timeout, memory, maxItems, maxTotalChargeUsd
---
kind: Run.Sequence
metadata: { name: main }
steps:
  - name: scrape
    invoke: !ref scrape
    inputs:
      Account: []
```

- **`Run`** calls Apify's synchronous endpoint and returns `{ items }`. Apify holds the request open for at most 300 seconds; a longer run fails with HTTP 408.
- **`Start`** starts the run, long-polls it until it finishes, and returns `{ run, items }`. A run that ends `FAILED`, `TIMED-OUT` or `ABORTED` raises `APIFY_RUN_NOT_SUCCEEDED` with the run as `data`.

## Input

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Account` | array | yes |  | Account — Add a list of Account. You can add them one per line. |
| `resultsLimit` | integer | yes | `200` | Number of Follower/Following per account — Maximum followers or following profiles to return per account: 25 to 500,000. This is a maximum, not a guaranteed total. Available public data, free-plan limits, and the run budget may reduce the number returned. |
| `dataToScrape` | string | yes | `"Followers"` | What do you want to scrape from each account? — choose between Follower and Following |
| `continuationToken` | string |  |  | Continuation Token — Optional. Find this token in the previous run: Storage > default key-value store > OUTPUT. If available, copy nextContinuationToken from the matching account in the continuations list and paste it here. Use only that same account in Account and keep the same Followers/Followings |
